references.phrase: maximal element of a collection under inclusion
references.context: Order theory: a maximal element m in a nonempty family F of subsets of an ambient set, ordered by inclusion, is one with no distinct member B∈F properly containing m. Maximal need not mean greatest, and for ideals the family F is any specified nonempty subcollection of the ideals of R.
references.reason: Maximality in a partially ordered collection is independently reusable beyond the Noetherian-ring property and should not be confused with an ideal maximal among all proper ideals.
